name: Alertness
description: Not much gets by this hero. He's very observant amd perceptive, and adds +2 to his Notice rolls to hear, see, or otherwise sense the world around him.

name: Ambidextrous
description:
Your warrior is as deft with his left hand as he is with his right. He ifnores the Off-Hand penalty.
If holding a weapon in each hand, Ambidextrous characters may stack Parry bonuses (if any) from both weapons.
summary: Ignore -2 penalty when making Trait rolls with off-hand.
